✂️ Master Tailoring & Fabrication Guide

How Each Church Design is Tailored & Assembled

Official engineering specifications for church tailors, fabric sourcing merchants, and department directors. View the realistic tailoring craftsmanship alongside architectural blueprints and sizing yardages.

Men's Bespoke Vest & Lapel Workmanship
Notice the 2mm gold piping along the double-breasted vest closure, the firm chest canvas roll, the full Windsor knot with horizontal tie bar, and the official JCRGM gold cross lapel badge.
Ladies' Capelet & Neckline Workmanship
Demonstrates the structured ivory capelet with dense metallic bullion embroidery along the scalloped hem, a modest boat/jewel neckline with official gold brooch, and sculpted saucer fascinator.
Men's Bespoke Royal Suit Architecture
• Chest Piece: Medium-firm horsehair canvas interfacing.
• Seam Allowances: 1.0 inch (2.5 cm) on side seams for future adjustments.
• Hem Finish: Blind-stitched with 1.5-inch trouser turn-up.
Ladies' Royal Peplum & Cape Silhouette
• Modesty Rule: Hemline strictly 3 inches below knees.
• Interfacing: Fusible woven Vilene in neckline and peplum flare.
• Fastener: 22-inch invisible YKK back zipper with hook-and-eye clasp.
African Royal Kaftan & Placket Embroidery
• Placket Embroidery: 4.5mm satin bullion stitch with gold metallic thread.
• Side Ease Slits: 7-inch side openings to allow clean access to trouser pockets.
• Fabric Quality: 100% Combed Polished Cotton or Austrian Brocade.

📍 Lusaka Fabric Sourcing & Procurement Directory
Recommended Markets in Lusaka, Zambia:
• Kamwala Textile Market: Main Lane (Shops 14–22) — Best pricing for heavy crepe, Duchess satin, Austrian damask rolls, and uniform bulk yardage.
• Cairo Road Suiting Merchants: Premium Super 120s wool blends, cashmere suiting, and breathable Bemberg linings.
• Freedom Way / Lumumba Road Depots: Authentic 100% cotton Zambian Chitenge wax prints in rich purple, royal navy, and sunburst gold.
• Procurement Advice for Department Leads: Always order from one single fabric bolt/dye-lot for the entire department to ensure 100% color matching under altar stage lights.
